Hi Isabel,

Thanks for sending these over and for the clear sample invoice. A few items our procurement/tax team needs to confirm before we can enable PO processing and invoice acceptance in our AP system:

1) Can you confirm whether your e-invoice XML uses the Spanish Facturae schema or PEPPOL BIS? The sample looks proprietary; we need a mapping or a PEPPOL envelope for automated ingestion.

2) On reverse-charge: Redwood is a UK/US-led org and for EU customers we validate the buyer VAT number to determine reverse-charge applicability. Please confirm whether you issue invoices net of Spanish VAT when the buyer provides a valid VAT number (we will supply the Redwood VAT ID at PO time).

3) PO split: Our finance system supports splitting a single Redwood PO across multiple internal billing entities (cost center routing). If you need us to include a specific reference field in your invoice (e.g., PO:58721|Entity:RED-EU), tell me the exact label/key you can parse so we can pass standard metadata.

4) Bank wiring: we may require a bank-confirmed beneficiary name or bank connectivity (SEPA IBAN check) for non-US suppliers. Please attach a bank confirmation for the IBAN you plan to use.

Cc'ing Ben Carter from Tax & Vendor Setup to confirm expected NIF validation steps and whether the signed PDF you attached is sufficient evidence for VAT-exempt treatment.

Next step: once we have the PEPPOL/Fel/Facturae mapping and bank proof, we can create the vendor record and issue the PO.

Quick follow-up from tax:

Hi all,

Thanks for the docs, Isabel. Short answers and actions:

- NIF check: B12345678 looks syntactically valid for a Spanish company (letter + 8 digits). We will run this through VIES to confirm the VAT registration status after we receive the buyer VAT (Redwood EU VAT) at PO creation. Please expect one confirmation email from our team.

- Evidence: the signed company certificate PDF is acceptable as initial onboarding evidence. For VAT-exempt/reverse-charge treatment we need either a) a VIES positive match showing your VAT status OR b) an official registrar extract (Registro Mercantil) showing active status. The signed PDF alone will allow us to provision the vendor but not to automatically skip VAT validation.

- e-invoice format: we prefer PEPPOL BIS formatted invoices for automated ingestion. If you cannot produce PEPPOL, a Facturae 3.2 (Spain) export is our second choice. The attached sample XML is fine for a manual check but we'll need a schema map.

- PO metadata: please include the following exact reference in the invoice when Redwood issues PO 58721: "PO:58721|ENTITY:RED-EU" — our ingestion looks for the pipe-delimited key. If your accounting system can't use the pipe, use a space-separated label 'PO:58721 ENTITY:RED-EU' and add a short note in the invoice XML under <Reference>.

- Bank: submit a bank statement or a SEPA confirmation PDF showing the IBAN and legal name. That satisfies our bank-confirm step.

If you can send the Facturae or PEPPOL sample and the IBAN proof early next week we will create the vendor, test one e-invoice ingestion in staging, and then issue the PO.

Best,
